model: AC Critical Power Monitor (CPM) for busway
applies_to: Starline (Legrand) AC Critical Power Monitors with firmware v4.21-v4.26, v4.21A-v4.26A or v5.02-v5.07.
summary: The AC CPM meters an infeed and up to six outlets, plus enclosure and node temperatures and breaker status. Its BACnet object list has 405 objects with a write-access level for each: device text fields, infeed voltages, currents, power, energy, demand and min/max values, per-outlet metering, alarm thresholds, hex alarm-status words and breaker status.
firmware: v4.26, v4.26A, v5.07 (list also valid for v4.21-v4.24 and v5.02-v5.05)
notes: Object names are generic and repeat (e.g. INFEED LINE CURRENT for lines 1-3 and neutral); the description column says which line, outlet or node each object is.
Access comes from the Write Access Level column: User or Admin = writable, '-' = read-only. Admin-level objects are marked in the description.

About 90% of the objects match the M70 CPM list, but it is not a drop-in copy: it has no OUTLET 1 IDENTIFIER (CSV 14), no NUMBER OF BREAKERS, no breaker 5-6 status and no identify/reboot BVs, and the breaker objects are numbered differently (breaker alarm PIV 11, breaker 1-2 status PIV 13-14). Use the M70 list only for M70 meters.
The object list does not state the BACnet transport or network settings.
Source: AC CPM BACNet Object List, revision 4 (3/3/2023), pages 2-10 (405 objects).

integration.summary: Read the infeed totals (energy, active power, average current and voltage, power factor) and the per-line currents, plus the infeed and outlet alarm status words. Add per-outlet metering for each plug-in unit you need to bill or monitor.
gotchas: Many objects share the same name; map by object type and instance, not by name.
Alarm thresholds, ratings and resets are writable; Admin-level writes need the admin access level. Don't write them cyclically.
